claim: This ledger identifies the PDF files actually supplied for the DORN 4.0 senior rebuild. It does not claim that every requirement is implemented.

sourceSet.duplicatePolicy: Byte-identical copies share one requirement source but both attachments remain recorded.

precedence: Explicit user decisions in the DORN 4.0 senior rebuild
CURRENT decisions in PDF-PLAN-CURRENT-20260810 and PDF-CODEX-PARITY-P0
Historical sections only where they do not contradict newer decisions

userOverrides.decision: The original DORN 4.0 splash is mandatory for exactly 7000 ms even though the master PDF allowed faster warm start.
DORN 4.0 menu, products, themes, backgrounds, GIFs, color customization and visual identity are canonical; the 4.9 renderer is not.
Normal providers, including Kimi, must connect from the searchable AI catalog by pasting a key; users must not repair JSON templates.
userOverrides.evidence: Kimi uses the official OpenAI-compatible endpoint and current kimi-k3 fallback, filters discovered models to the Kimi family, activates only after a non-empty live response, removes failed temporary connections and restores active edits transactionally. Search results for Kimi/Kimi K2 in the encyclopedia now resolve to this same automatic assistant instead of a blank advanced JSON template. A user key is still required for live external verification.

userOverrides.decision: DORN must allow users to add complements such as Skills and plugins, with an easy UI and without granting trust merely because a package installs.
userOverrides.nextGate: Supply Chain Guard plus Skill/Plugin Trust Pipeline: manifest translation, provenance, version, license, hash/signature, permission diff, quarantine, isolated Compatibility Lab, per-project activation, rollback and removal. The legacy PluginEngine remains UI-disabled because its declared permissions are not yet fully enforced.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Computer Use Runtime
currentRequirementGroups.nextEvidence: Operate an authorized real application and link observation, action and result to Evidence.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Screenshot Evidence Capture
currentRequirementGroups.gap: No native Computer Use capture driver yet.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Browser Automation Runtime
currentRequirementGroups.gap: The professional Web Golden Project is authored, tested, integrated and statically evidenced through the trusted runtime, but no executable browser is available here for real DOM, accessibility tree, console, network, responsive, keyboard or screenshot Evidence.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Agent Session Broker
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Project-bound durable sessions now implement lifecycle, checkpoints, restart recovery, attach/detach, bounded streams, health, usage/quota and hash-chained CrossAgentHandoff with source/Evidence/ContextPack invalidation. No external agent runtime has been executed through the broker yet.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Codex AgentRuntimeAdapter
currentRequirementGroups.gap: The full adapter method contract, safe registry, executable hashing, shell-free health/help discovery, TOCTOU defense, bounded ContextPack requirement and broker connection exist. Codex is not installed in this environment and start/resume/run/stream/artifact/usage/cancel/benchmark remain explicitly NOT_IMPLEMENTED rather than simulated.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Windows Shell Adapter
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Execution is shell-free, scoped and observable; Windows Job Object containment and the legacy direct terminal path still require migration and a real Windows retest.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Skill Runtime and Trust Pipeline
currentRequirementGroups.gap: A legacy DORN PluginEngine can inventory/copy packages and run a very small VM command surface, but its requested permissions are not yet capability-enforced and the 4.0 UI correctly keeps it disabled. Declarative Skills, Claude/Codex/Gemini compatibility, provenance, signature/license/SBOM checks, quarantine, per-project activation, sensitive process/network/model/MCP/LSP gates and rollback must be completed through Supply Chain Guard before users can add complements safely.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Automated Visual Verification
currentRequirementGroups.gap: The Web Golden runtime records a separate BLOCKED visual Evidence entry instead of inferring quality from HTML/CSS. Browser/computer-use runners and the independent screenshot critic remain.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Execution Target Registry
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Node test/build and Git inspection targets are hash-pinned; browser, Godot, Windows shell, WSL and SSH targets remain.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Project Integrity Engine and predictive impact
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Architecture ownership, complexity and 100-change long-horizon gate remain incomplete.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Verification Fabric 2.0
currentRequirementGroups.gap: A scoped process/test/build executor and an exact-byte Web Golden route exist; browser, computer use, performance and critic executors remain.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Durable Job Kernel
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Scoped process/test/build execution, bounded ContextPacks and persistent structured agent handoff exist; external agent executors and complete automatic failover remain.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Context Compiler 2.0 and Working Set
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Durable identity-bound ContextPacks now include exact source hashes, provenance, freshness, budgets, selection reasons, secret exclusion, Evidence snapshots and targeted invalidation. The agent/session boundary rejects absent, stale and cross-Job packs, and a 1,500-file project remains bounded. Symbol-level semantic indexing and automatic ingestion of all runtime observations are still partial.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Contract Intelligence
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Project-bound durable baselines, producer/consumer/test mapping, conservative JSON Schema/OpenAPI JSON/Protobuf comparison and an automatic Worktree integration gate are active. OpenAPI YAML, AsyncAPI, generated types, full external-reference resolution and Evidence-native isolated contract-test execution remain partial.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Data Intelligence
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Project-bound schema inspection, bounded/redacted queries, consistent snapshots, representative migration checks, destructive-change blocking, exact Evidence, backup, idempotent apply and rollback are active. Full lineage, automatic migration planning, large-workload worker isolation and integration with every DORN product editor remain partial.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Intelligence Gateway 2.0
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Provider, Model, AccessRoute, Connection and CredentialRef are normalized separately without API material. Durable attempts implement health probes, transactional quota reservation/renewal, observed-only cost and latency, circuit breaker, cooldown, one bounded retry, exact-context failover checkpoints, compatible credential load balancing, model-list cache and crash recovery. Kimi/Kimi K2 resolve from catalog search to the one-key Moonshot flow. Live keys are still required to produce external-provider Evidence; cross-provider semantic failover and task-response caching remain deliberately unclaimed.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Harness x Model x Skill x Tool Benchmarking
currentRequirementGroups.gap: The exact model, harness, access route, skills, tools and context strategy combination is stored in an owner-bound SQLite ledger. Cold-start routing is explainable; only official independently attested Evidence over the same task, bytes, output and metrics can affect ranking. Unverified telemetry, duplicate Evidence, self-evaluation and Shadow/Candidate output cannot manipulate selection. Shadow/Candidate requires an active Worktree and produces a comparison without silently becoming official. Live provider/runtime candidate executions and an approved promotion/canary pipeline remain pending.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Safe multi-agent concurrency
currentRequirementGroups.gap: A project-bound durable Task Graph now enforces acyclic dependencies, a 64-node/8-parallel ceiling, deterministic waves, marginal-utility gating, redundant-work cancellation, temporary path ownership including parent/child conflicts, isolated Worktrees for writers, crash interruption and claim release. The real confirmed multi-IA chat path records and claims each node and preserves deterministic result order. Candidate selection requires independent exact Evidence and only the selected winner may cross the Worktree integration gate. Live multi-runtime write experiments and scale telemetry over large real repositories remain pending.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Agent Runtime Fabric 2.0 and structured handoff
currentRequirementGroups.gap: The DORN-owned session/handoff authority, bounded ContextPack boundary and versioned adapter registry are integrated. Live task adapters, authorized hot loading and real Codex/Claude/Gemini execution remain.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Environment Capsule
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Environment Capsule 2.0 separates declared target OS/architecture and explicit project requirements from current-PC observations. It statically detects Node/package-manager, Python, Rust, Go, .NET, CMake, PlatformIO and Godot signals without executing project scripts; checks registered or fixed-contract tool versions and hashes; records only presence for non-secret variables; gates service probes; preserves A→B→A identity; and rejects corrupt, linked, HTTP, credential-bearing or ambiguous sources. Preparation is plan-only and hands only approved HTTPS + hash/signature + license sources to Supply Chain Guard. An authorized clean dependency preparation and reproducible build on a second environment remain unproven.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Policy and Security Plane
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Scoped filesystem/process/network/secret policy, one-use approvals and hostile tests exist. Network isolation is not enforceable for the local Node target, Windows process trees need Job Objects, and the legacy chat action path still requires migration.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Supply Chain Guard
currentRequirementGroups.gap: Environment Capsule now blocks ambiguous dependency preparation and emits only source-pinned plans. The next unit must implement verified fetch/quarantine, transitive inventory, license, vulnerabilities, permissions, SBOM/provenance and artifact admission for libraries, CLIs, models, templates, plugins and Skills.

currentRequirementGroups.name: Ultra UX and Performance
currentRequirementGroups.gap: The DORN 4.0 product identity remains protected and the generated web foundation passes static/hostile gates, but fresh visual Evidence in a real browser remains blocked.

nextExactGap: Supply Chain Guard plus Skill/Plugin Trust Pipeline: verified fetch and quarantine, provenance, exact version/hash/signature, license, transitive dependency and vulnerability inventory, permission diff, SBOM, isolated Compatibility Lab, per-project activation and rollback. This is required before exposing user-added complements such as Claude/Codex/Gemini-compatible Skills or enabling the legacy PluginEngine. Environment Capsule clean-build Evidence, live multi-runtime/provider evidence, Codex execution and browser visual Evidence remain pending or blocked.
